description: Meta Platforms, Inc. has a mission to build the future of human connection and the technology that makes it possible, and its products enable people to connect and share through mobile devices, personal computers, virtual reality headsets and AI glasses. It is innovating in artificial intelligence technologies to build transformative experiences and capabilities across its Family of Apps and new platforms, and to advance its vision to deliver personal superintelligence for everyone, building technology that helps people connect and share, find and build communities, and grow businesses, and helping people discover and learn about what is going on in the world around them, share their experiences, ideas, photos and videos with audiences ranging from their closest family members and friends to the public at large, and stay connected everywhere by accessing its products. Meta is moving its offerings beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next computing platform, and its wearables efforts include AI glasses such as the Ray-Ban Meta and Oakley Meta glasses featuring Meta AI, its advanced conversational assistant, and hands-free interaction.
